//: Central UI theme for the RmlUi menus. 'rcss' values fill {{token}} placeholders in data/gui/*.rcss; 'game_colors' override the nc_color->hex used for menu text. Editable live in the F4 Theme tab.

rcss.//: hud-veil is the sidebar HUD's translucent panel ground and hud-veil-0 its zero-alpha twin, needed because token substitution is textual and a gradient stop cannot derive an alpha from another token. The alpha 0xd1 = 0.82 is measured, not chosen: regressing a rendered panel against the bare world behind it is what put the readable floor there. hud-scan/hud-scan-glass are the per-panel and full-screen scanline inks, hud-vig the faceplate corner darkening. The HUD's TEXT colours are not here: it spends the shared gruvbox ladder (bg-hard, bg2, bg4, fg4, fg, fg0) so it cannot drift from the character creator, and its only accent is {{yellow}}.
